optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation
professionalSummary: Project manager with three years of experience leading cold storage warehouse automation projects, delivering installation plans, phased aisle hand‑overs, contractor management, and closure documentation under the operator's project method.
experienceHighlights: Led automation projects for two frozen‑goods warehouses, executing installation plans and phased aisle hand‑overs per the operator's project method.
Briefed warehouse shift teams on each phase using the change briefing standard, producing signed briefing records for fourteen phases.
Managed the automation contractor under the works contract, issuing site instructions and twelve defect notices with contractor responses.
Prepared aisle hand‑over acceptance packs, documenting responsibilities and confirming acceptance with the warehouse manager.
Authored closure reports containing project boundary statements and acceptance test evidence signed by the contractor and warehouse manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Installation plan with phased hand‑over schedule; two signed phase briefing records; one aisle acceptance pack with manager acceptance; one closure report, all referenced in the programme repository.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and deliverables for the target role, but do not provide independent verification beyond the cited documents.

role.roleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation

evidence.text: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of project management and phased hand‑over

evidence.text: Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.
Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.
evidence.notes: Acceptance pack preparation and responsibility boundaries

evidence.text: Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.
